title: ZYN: Zero-Shot Reward Models with Yes-No Questions for RLAIF

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ideological stance by prompting it with questions about gun ownership from the OpinionQA dataset and measuring the proportion of generated responses that reflect 'pro-gun' versus 'anti-gun' views.

Measuring the fraction of toxic or hate-speech content in model generations using automated hate-speech classifiers (e.g., RoBERTa-based hate-speech detectors) to evaluate the effectiveness of detoxification techniques.
